$comment: Deployed edge-function slug -> source file. Slugs are the live Supabase slugs; the app maps its camelCase names to them in src/api/entities.js (FUNCTION_MAP). verify_jwt is NOT set here: deploy-functions.mjs reads it from the live project so a redeploy can never flip it. A slug that does not already exist remotely is refused unless listed in allowCreate. Live functions with no source in this repo (unsplash) are never deployed from here.
